images.title: List squares until you hit 576
images.purpose: Shows the squares from 20 squared to 24 squared listed in order until 576 is reached, so the square root of 576 is 24.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. A short vertical stack of five cards in the centre with one result below.
images.exact_structure: Exactly 5 equal cards stacked vertically, reading from top to bottom 20² = 400, 21² = 441, 22² = 484, 23² = 529 and 24² = 576. The top four cards are white with a thin grey (#6B7280) outline; the bottom card is filled reddish purple (#CC79A7) with white text. Below the stack, centred: √576 = 24. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Listing the squares near a number finds its square root.

image_decisions.why: A short ladder of squares that stops on 576 shows the listing method in one step.
